image_description: A wooden bookshelf filled with numerous comic books and graphic novels. The top shelf displays spines of various colorful trade paperbacks (e.g., 'Spider-Man', 'X-Men'). The middle shelves contain stacks of loose, single-issue comic books piled horizontally, some slightly fanned out or disorganized. The bottom shelf shows a few more items and the edge of a drawer. The image captures a collection rather than a single isolated comic book.

The wood grain texture is somewhat repetitive and lacks fine detail, appearing slightly plastic or smudged rather than naturally fibrous.
